parent_objective: design measured execution for the bounded calibration smoke
blocked_by: need execution protocol before measured rollout over bounded subset
supersedes: direct bounded calibration smoke execution after M1706

public_gates: M1707 must design execution over the M1705 864-cell bounded smoke matrix without running it
M1707 must require outcome and termination aggregates
M1707 must keep task-quality calibration separate from controller-family ranking
M1707 must not train replay PPO promote use private holdout or change actor inputs
M1707 must not claim controller-family ranking, paper-level evidence, private-holdout evidence, or level3 self-ID

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs measured execution after clean bounded subset audit
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: execution design only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if design would rank profiles directly
stop if design omits outcome/termination aggregates
stop if design drops resume/failure handling
stop if design changes actor inputs or profile configs
fallback_plan: route to measured bounded execution if design is accepted
route to runner repair design if existing runner cannot consume the subset
route to branch synthesis if task-quality calibration remains underdefined
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1706 admits bounded smoke execution design

admission_evidence: M1706 audits the M1705 bounded smoke subset as clean
blocked_shortcuts: do not run environment rollout in M1707
do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1707 status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: required artifacts and metrics are specified

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1707 is design-only and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: design must keep L1, L2-current-tiled, L3-online, and L3-reset rows in the execution matrix
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1705 subset and M1706 audit only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If execution design cannot preserve controls and task-quality metrics, stop before execution.
allowed_claims: no rollout, no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no promotion, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A measured execution protocol can be designed for the M1705 bounded calibration smoke without overclaiming or changing the actor contract.
success_criteria: execution input and output artifacts are specified
outcome and termination aggregates are required
rollout execution training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: design changes actor inputs or profile configs
training replay PPO private holdout promotion or level3 claims occur

commands.name: design
commands.command: write bounded calibration smoke execution design

decision_rule: M1707 passes if it designs bounded calibration smoke execution while preserving task-quality claim boundaries.
